# Amazon Bedrock Overview — captured 2026-07-03

## What's New (newest at top)

- **OpenAI GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 now available in Amazon Bedrock** (NEW since 2026-06 cache): OpenAI's frontier models for complex professional work, agentic coding, reasoning, and long-running tasks, available through the Responses API on Amazon Bedrock. [Crosses bar — new models/agentic-coding capability on a governed inference surface. Model availability alone is borderline, but frontier agentic-coding models on Bedrock runtime are worth tracking. MEDIUM.]
- **Claude Opus 4.7 now available in Amazon Bedrock** (in prior cache): Anthropic's most capable Opus model, improvements across agentic coding, professional work, long-running tasks.
- **Claude Mythos Preview (Gated Research Preview)** (in prior cache): Anthropic's most advanced model, state-of-the-art cybersecurity, software coding, complex reasoning. Gated preview in US East (N. Virginia).
- **Cost allocation by IAM user and role** (in prior cache): Cost allocation by IAM principal in CUR 2.0 and Cost Explorer; attributes inference costs across users/teams/projects.
- Claude Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 (prior cache) — no longer surfaced in What's New but retained for context.

## Supported APIs
1. Messages API (Anthropic) — example now uses anthropic.claude-opus-4-7
2. Responses API (OpenAI Compatible) — example now uses openai.gpt-oss-120b
3. Chat Completions API (OpenAI Compatible)
4. Converse API (Boto3)
5. Invoke API (Boto3)

## Supported Foundation Models (100+)
Featured providers shown: Amazon Nova, Claude (Anthropic), DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot AI), MiniMax, OpenAI

## Key Capabilities
1. Model Inference
2. Model Customization
3. Enterprise Security
4. Flexible APIs (OpenAI-compatible, Boto3, native)
5. Server-side Tools

Updated: 2026-07-03 — NEW since last scan: OpenAI GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 added to What's New (Responses API). Prior What's New entries (Opus 4.7, Mythos preview, IAM cost allocation) unchanged.
